chunks: My father `Ali b. Ahmad (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us from Sahl b. Ziyad al-Adami from `Abd al-Athim b. `Abdullah al-Hasani from `Ali [Traducción]

b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. Musa b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as). He said: When Allah spoke to Musa b. `Imran (as), Musa said: My God! What is el reward of one who bears witness that I am Your messenger and Your prophet, and that You have spoken to me? He said: O Musa! My angels will come to him and give him glad tidings of My Paradise. Musa (as) said: My God! What is el reward of one who stands before You and prays? He said: O Musa! I boast about him to My angels when he is bowing, prostrating, standing, and sitting. I do not punish whoever I boast about to My angels. Musa (as) said: My God! What is el reward of one who feeds a poor person for Your sake? He said: O Musa! I will order My caller on el Day of Resurrection to call above el heads of el creatures: "So-and-so el son of so-and-son is from those freed by Allah from el Fire [Traducción]

." Musa (as) said: My God! What is el reward of one who connects with his blood-relative? He said: O Musa! I will give him harmony in his life, I will waive el pangs of death from him; and el treasury of Paradise will call to him: "Come to us and enter from whichever gate you wish." Musa (as) said: My God! What is el reward of one who abstains from harming el people and establishes noble virtues with them? He said: O Musa! On el Day of Resurrection, el Fire will call to him: "You have no way to get to me." He said: My God! What is el reward of one who remembers You with his tongue and his heart? He said: O Musa! I will shade him on el Day of Resurrection with el shade of My Throne, and I will put him under My auspices. He said: My God! What is el reward of one who relates Your wisdom privately and publicly? He said: O Musa! He will pass through el Path like [Traducción]

lightning. He said: My God! What is el reward of one who is patient upon el harm and el insults of el people for Your sake? He said: I will assist them in el horrors of el Day of Resurrection. He said: My God! What is el reward of one whose eyes fill with tears out of humility before You? He said: O Musa! I will protect his face from el heat of el Fire, and I will protect him on el Great Day of Dismay. He said: My God! What is el reward of one who abandons betrayal out of shyness before You? He said: O Musa! He will have protection on el Day of Resurrection. He said: My God! What is el reward of one who loves those who obey You? He said: O Musa! I will prohibit him from My Fire. He said: O My God! What is el recompense of one who purposely kills a believer? He said: I will not look to him on el Day of Resurrection, nor will I dismiss his falter. He said: M [Traducción]

y God! What is el reward of one who calls a disbeliever to Islam? He said: O Musa! I will permit him to seek intercession from whomever he wishes on el Day of Resurrection. He said: My God! What is el reward of one who prays his prayers on time? He said: I will give him what he asks for, and I will permit My Paradise to him. He said: My God! What is el reward of one who completes his ablution in humility before You? He said: I will resurrect him on el Day of Resurrection with a twinkling light upon his forehead. He said: My God! What is el reward of one who fasts el month of Ramadan for You in anticipation? He said: O Musa! I will put him in a station on el Day of Resurrection in which he will not experience fear. He said: My God! What is el recompense of one who fasts el month of Ramadan for el sake of el people? He said: O Musa! His recompense is like that of he who does not fast it. [Traducción]
ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from al-Amali al-Saduq teach? [es]
